title: Walk-rigid apex (Theorem WR) is reconstructible
statement_en: Theorem WR, walk-rigid apex (round-14 t2.md (Theorem H, aligned Hagos) and t3.md (Theorems DWC, WR) in the phantom_and_mate directory of the diameter-2 branch): every graph G on at least 3 vertices with a vertex x such that the only integer vector δ with δ x = 0, δ ∈ {0, −1} on N(x), δ ∈ {0, 1} off N(x), summing to zero over every degree class of the card G − x, and orthogonal to every walk vector of G − x (edges at x removed, k ≥ 0) is δ = 0, is reconstructible.
statement_lean: Recon.ClassReconstructible (fun n G => ∃ x : Fin n, ∀ w : ℕ → Fin n → ℤ, (∀ y : Fin n, w 0 y = 1) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ y : Fin n, w (k + 1) y = ∑ z : Fin n, Set.indicator {z : Fin n | G.Adj y z ∧ y ≠ x ∧ z ≠ x} (w k) z) → ∀ δ : Fin n → ℤ, δ x = 0 → (∀ y : Fin n, G.Adj x y → δ y = 0 ∨ δ y = -1) → (∀ y : Fin n, ¬ G.Adj x y → δ y = 0 ∨ δ y = 1) → (∀ j : ℕ, ∑ y : Fin n, Set.indicator {y : Fin n | {z : Fin n | G.Adj y z ∧ z ≠ x}.ncard = j} δ y = 0) → (∀ k : ℕ, ∑ y : Fin n, δ y * w k y = 0) → δ = 0)
author: round14
